name: workbuddy-market
description: WorkBuddy Market 仓库自带插件市场：内容随仓库 bundled/ 目录提交固定（相对路径引用，零漂移）。想要每日重建的 25+ 精选社区目录，请改用 /plugin marketplace add https://github.com/zjs105910/workbuddy-market.git#marketplace

plugins.name: novel-writing-suite
plugins.description: 中文网文创作全流程：扫榜选题、长篇与短篇写作、长篇与短篇拆文、多视角审查、去 AI 味、逆向导入、封面生成，外加工具集基础设施部署。12 个互相路由的 skill 组成一条完整流水线，入口是 story。
plugins.description_en: A complete Chinese web-novel writing pipeline: trend scanning, long/short-form drafting, long/short-form deconstruction, multi-perspective review, AI-flavour removal, reverse import, and cover art generation.

plugins.name: github-project-manager
plugins.description: 把 GitHub 上的开源项目和技能包装到本机并持续维护：预检、安装、列出、扫描、检查更新、一键更新、移除、回滚、数据完整性校验与环境诊断。带原子锁、心跳租约、事务级失败回滚、内容指纹校验和 ZIP 安全防护。
plugins.description_en: Install and maintain open-source projects and skill packs from GitHub: inspect, add, list, scan, check, update, remove, rollback, verify and doctor. Atomic locking, transactional rollback, content fingerprinting and ZIP hardening.

plugins.name: browser-cdp
plugins.description: 通过 Chrome DevTools Protocol 驱动真实 Chrome，复用已有登录态：以调试模式启动、打开页面、等待加载、点击与取数、截图。适合需要登录后才能访问的站点。
plugins.description_en: Drive a real Chrome over the DevTools Protocol while reusing existing login sessions: launch in debug mode, open URLs, wait for load, evaluate, click and screenshot.
